description: Turn a trip into up to three plan recommendations: countries (1-5, any language), number of days and how much data the traveller uses. Each fit carries the full plan facts, the total price for the whole trip and a one-sentence reason built only from catalogue facts. Use this first whenever the user describes a trip rather than asks for a list.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. "en-gb", "de-de". Wins over language; prices and links are quoted in it.

budget.description: Optional maximum total for the trip, in the result currency.

countries.description: Countries or regions of the trip, any language.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code. Every price in the result is quoted in it.

gb_per_day.description: Overrides usage with an explicit daily need in GB.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Plan names and country names come back in it when available. Bare "en" is quoted in en-us / USD.

usage.description: light ≈ 0.5 GB/day (maps, messaging), normal ≈ 1.5 GB/day (social, some video), heavy ≈ 4 GB/day (video, hotspot). Default normal.

name: recommend_plan

plan.description: One eSIM plan. Every field is present only when the catalogue holds a value for it; an absent field is unknown, never "no".

activation_trigger.description: "install": validity and billing start the moment the eSIM is installed — install only when ready to use. "first_connection": the eSIM can be installed before travel; validity starts on first connection to a network at the destination.

always_on_rate.description: Unlimited Flex / Daily Pack: reduced speed after the daily allowance, e.g. "512 Kbit/s". Empty when the plan has a speed_cap or is unlimited.

apn.description: APN to set when the vendor requires one.

coverage_countries.description: Every country the plan works in, with the network operators per country when known.

name.description: Country name in the requested language.

networks.description: Operator names in that country, as the supplier lists them.

coverage_note.description: Coverage caveat to present verbatim, e.g. traffic routed via Hong Kong.

covers_via.description: Present when the plan was returned for a country it covers as part of a multi-country plan: the plan's own region name.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of every price in this object.

daily_high_speed.description: Unlimited Flex / Daily Pack: daily allowance at full speed, e.g. "2GB"; "unlimited" = unlimited data every day at full speed (fair-use policy).

daily_reset_time.description: When the daily allowance resets, as the vendor states it (clock and time zone). Absent = resets 24 h after activation is NOT implied; simply unknown.

data.description: Data Pack: total data label, e.g. "5GB".

data_gb.description: Data amount in GB. Meaning given by data_period.

data_period.description: "total": data_gb is the whole plan (Data Pack). "per_day": data_gb is the daily full-speed allowance (Unlimited Flex, Daily Pack).

days.description: Validity in days (Data Pack, Daily Pack).

days_range.description: Unlimited Flex: choosable durations in days, e.g. "1-30".

expires_on.description: Stock expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the product itself has one.

fair_use.description: Fair-use policy text from the supplier, when stated.

hotspot.description: Hotspot / tethering rule as the vendor states it, e.g. "Supported" or a device limit.

install_before_travel.description: true when the eSIM can safely be installed before departure (activation_trigger first_connection).

ip_breakout.description: Country whose internet connection the customer appears to use (IP breakout), ISO code(s) — matters for banking apps, streaming and mainland-China access. Vendor fact.

kyc_required.description: true when the vendor requires real-name registration (ID verification) on arrival before data works.

last_updated.description: Date the plan was last updated in the catalogue (YYYY-MM-DD).

name.description: Short plan name: destination · data · validity · type.

network_generation.description: Network technology, e.g. "4G/LTE/5G". Never an operator name.

networks.description: Operator names across the plan (deduplicated). Per-country detail is in coverage_countries.

plan_note.description: One-sentence vendor fact to present verbatim when present; overrides the generic type description.

price.description: Price in currency, read WITH price_basis: the full price of the plan when "total", the price of ONE day when "per_day". Never a per-GB rate. The price shown is the price paid.

price_is_final.description: Always true: no tax or fee is added at checkout.

price_max.description: Only on price_basis "per_day": the price for the longest duration in days_range, discount applied — the figure to quote for a full period. Never infer it by multiplying.

pricing_bucket.description: language-region bucket the prices and links are quoted in, e.g. "en-us".

product_id.description: Product id. Use it for get_plan_details and start_checkout.

rating.description: Average customer rating (1-5). Present only when reviews exist.

refund_class.description: Vendor refund/cancellation class for this plan.

refund_rule.description: The refund class in words - present verbatim.

review_count.description: Number of reviews. Present only when > 0.

speed_cap.description: Present only on plans with a PERMANENT speed cap, e.g. "10 Mbit/s". Never call such a plan high-speed.

start_date_required.description: true when a start date must be chosen at checkout.

summary.description: Short description in the requested language, from the product page.

title.description: Full product title in the requested language.

kind.description: What TopUp can add without a new eSIM: data (Data Pack), days (Unlimited Flex / Daily Pack), or none.

transparency.description: A per-order Transparency link shows remaining data in near real-time.

unused_valid_days.description: Days the eSIM may remain unused after purchase before it expires (supplier value).

url.description: Product page in pricing_bucket. Use verbatim.

voice_sms.description: Always "none": data only, no telephone number, no SMS.

plans_needed.description: 1, or the number of consecutive Data Packs needed to cover the trip length.

total_for_trip.description: Checkout total for the trip in currency (Flex: days x per-day price with the discount ladder; packs: the plan price, times the number of plans needed when one does not cover the trip).

why.description: One sentence built from catalogue facts only.

title: Recommend a plan for a trip
